original_value: The current study proposes a numerical method which solves nonlinear Fredholm and Volterra integral of the second kind using a combination of a Newton–Kantorovich and Haar wavelet. Error analysis for the Holder classes was established to ensure convergence of the Haar wavelets. Numerical examples will illustrate the accuracy and simplicity of Newton–Kantorovich and Haar wavelets. Numerical results of the current method were then compared with previous well-established methods.

result.paraphrase: The present study presents a numerical technique for solving nonlinear Fredholm and Volterra integral equations of the second kind by combining Newton–Kantorovich with Haar wavelets. Error analysis for the Hölder classes was established to guarantee the convergence of the Haar wavelets. Numerical examples will demonstrate the accuracy and simplicity of the Newton–Kantorovich and Haar wavelets. The numerical results of this method were then compared with those of previously well-established methods.
